question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
-- Final query with proper formatting
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        m.id as movie_id,
        m.date_published,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),
director_with_prev_date AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        date_published,
        duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
)
SELECT 
    dwp.name_id,
    n.name as director_name,
    COUNT(*) as movie_count,
    CAST(ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM (dwp.date_published - dwp.prev_date))), 0) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    CAST(ROUND(AVG(dwp.avg_rating), 2) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as avg_rating,
    CAST(SUM(dwp.total_votes) AS BIGINT) as total_votes,
    CAST(MIN(dwp.avg_rating) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as min_rating,
    CAST(MAX(dwp.avg_rating) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) as max_rating,
    CAST(SUM(dwp.duration) AS BIGINT) as total_duration
FROM director_with_prev_date dwp
JOIN names n ON dwp.name_id = n.id
GROUP BY dwp.name_id, n.name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
